I write code with bugs for job security. Studied computer science and somehow made it everyone else’s problem. Licensed advanced drone pilot.

## A bit about me

- I like the outdoors and traveling.
- I am a drone pilot.
- I am still a hermit most days.
- I moderate communities on Twitch and Discord.
- I use Arch Linux and Windows.
- I am a big Hyprland fan.

## About this site

This site is where I publish project notes, experiments, and posts about coding, bots, Linux, and productivity.

## Contact

You can reach me through any social links in the header/footer, or by email at [deadcodexo@gmail.com](mailto:deadcodexo@gmail.com).
